# Thin-layer liquid lip color with less repeated amount adjustment

Status: `conditional_brief_for_user_evaluation`. User acceptance: pending (#327).

Reduce the manual effort needed to obtain the desired thin color layer while preserving an acceptable finish and wear routine. Occasional adjustment is allowed; zero wiping is not a specification.

## Target and observed workaround

Users seeking a thin wearable long-wear liquid color layer who repeatedly remove excess from the applicator. This is a behavior-based research segment; size and willingness to switch are unknown.

3 source-local identities across 2 sites and 3 dates support this research segment. Globally distinct people and market size are unverified. Original exact supporting spans are retained in the JSON evidence record.

- requirement: Thin even film with durable wear
- behavior: Removes applicator excess each use
- burden: Repeated excess removal
- trade_off: Applicator output mismatches the required tiny dose

## Selection and user decision

Original automatic wording: Apply an extremely thin long-wear liquid lip film without wiping excess from an overloading applicator.

This stronger no-wiping framing is frozen research history. The current objective above allows adjustment and is not evidence that the original stricter comparison passed.

Before this candidate's comparison, automatic selection: `long-wear-lip-dose-without-tip-wiping`.
With recorded comparisons, provisional automatic selection: `retinoid-tolerability-without-diy-dilution` (its alternatives/technical gates have not passed).

Actual release route: `user_provisional_adjudication`; [recorded user judgment](https://github.com/shk95-1/cosmai/issues/184#issuecomment-5847336264) at 2026-09-26T15:07:39Z.

User judges that concrete inconvenience remains compared with alternatives and permits bounded technical assessment of this previously automatically selected candidate. Target is less manual reduction, not an absolute zero-wiping requirement.

Original lip gate remains `reject` / `insufficient_alternative_evidence`; automatic qualified flag: `False`.

## Essential conditions

- Hypothesis: Loading should reduce repeated excess removal without requiring more dips or sacrificing even coverage. References: commerce_review:glowpick:7875575, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64286864, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64431208, geometry-formula-interaction.
- Hypothesis: Keep the desired thin-layer appearance and wearable result; select actual shade, finish and acceptance targets before testing. References: commerce_review:glowpick:7875575, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64286864, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64431208, film-property-guard.
- Hypothesis: Assess established formula and stock wiper/tip combinations first. Do not assume the observed commercial formula can be copied or a catalogue tip will work unchanged. References: commerce_review:glowpick:7875575, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64286864, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64431208, established-package-lever, existing-formulation-family.
- Hypothesis: Treat gloss-brush pigment cleaning as a separate requirement; a double-ended reservoir does not itself solve it. References: commerce_review:oliveyoung:64431208, dual-format-boundary.

## Trade-offs

- Hypothesis: A smaller or more strongly wiped tip could exchange wiping effort for extra dips, uneven coverage or stronger withdrawal force. References: commerce_review:glowpick:7875575, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64286864, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64431208, geometry-formula-interaction, force-and-tip-droplet.
- Hypothesis: Lower applied amount or a formula change could alter coverage, drying, comfort, transfer and wear. The cited study does not establish our formulation. References: commerce_review:glowpick:7875575, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64286864, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64431208, film-property-guard.
- Hypothesis: An existing alternative or a preferred prior tint may be more useful than a new package. Reported shade and touch-up preferences are separate from loading inconvenience. References: commerce_review:oliveyoung:64286864, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64431208.

## Likely failure modes

- Hypothesis: Variable loading with fill level, handling, viscosity or accumulated residue could erase the convenience gain. References: commerce_review:glowpick:7875575, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64286864, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64431208, geometry-formula-interaction.
- Hypothesis: Tight wiping could leave end droplets, damage flock, increase withdrawal force or require extra dipping. References: commerce_review:glowpick:7875575, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64286864, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64431208, force-and-tip-droplet, geometry-formula-interaction.
- Hypothesis: An easier-to-load package could still produce patchy color, poor wear or uncomfortable film. References: commerce_review:glowpick:7875575, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64286864, commerce_review:oliveyoung:64431208, film-property-guard.
- Hypothesis: Solvent, seal, adhesive or material incompatibility could make a stock pack unsuitable. References: established-package-lever.

## Established ingredient, formulation and manufacturing directions

Start with an established suitable base formula and stock wiper/tip matching, holding formula constant in package comparisons. Commercial silicone film-former families are a possible existing ingredient direction, not an adopted recipe. No synthesis of the paper's novel resin or reproduction of patented geometry is proposed.

### established-package-lever (agent_inference)

Existing molded wiping systems and stock lip applicators provide a plausible package-first development direction.

Material/component: Wiper, tip and stem; existing molded/flocked components. Conditions: Supplier specifications, not an empirical matched trial.

Case applicability: Directly addresses the observed repeated excess-removal action while initially holding the intended formula constant. Limits: No achieved reduction, reliable dose or compatibility is demonstrated.

[geka-wiper](https://www.geka-world.com/en/competences-innovations/wipers), [hcp-stock](https://www.hcpackaging.com/product/13mm-standard-al-cap/)

### geometry-formula-interaction (agent_inference)

Evaluate tip, wiper and formula together; a smaller tip alone is not a demonstrated solution.

Material/component: Tip surface/reservoir, wiping contact and product rheology. Conditions: Commercial qualitative viscosity classes and patent mechanisms; actual fill state and withdrawal handling unknown.

Case applicability: Can motivate a bounded comparison of existing component combinations. Limits: Smaller loading may trade manual wiping for extra dipping, patchy coverage or force; proposed variables are hypotheses.

[geka-catalogue](https://www.geka-world.com/fileadmin/user_upload/downloads/geka_product_catalogue.pdf), [paddle-wiper](https://patents.google.com/patent/US20130276817A1/en), [dior-droplet](https://patents.google.com/patent/US20220354236A1/en), [hcp-match](https://www.hcpackaging.com/category/lip-gloss-applicators/)

### force-and-tip-droplet (agent_inference)

Track withdrawal force and end droplets alongside loaded mass.

Material/component: Flexible wiping lip/sleeve. Conditions: Patent descriptions, with mascara examples for some force discussions.

Case applicability: An agent-proposed secondary failure mode for a package revision. Limits: No quantitative lip-force limit or patented geometry is adopted as a design requirement.

[dior-droplet](https://patents.google.com/patent/US20220354236A1/en), [loreal-force](https://patents.google.com/patent/US12150538B2/en)

### dual-format-boundary (agent_inference)

Separate base-dose control from gloss-brush cleaning in the proposed case.

Material/component: Existing double-ended reservoir format. Conditions: Supplier offers two reservoirs; consumer source evidence records cleaning as a distinct action.

Case applicability: Preserve the two-step option without claiming reservoir separation solves brush contamination. Limits: A wiping-friendly gloss tip is a separate hypothesis and not established by this supplier claim.

[hcp-duo](https://www.hcpackaging.com/inspiration/gloss-like-a-boss/)

### film-property-guard (agent_inference)

Preserve film/finish behavior while testing packaging; changing formula can introduce different wear/comfort trade-offs.

Material/component: Film-forming resin plus volatile carrier. Conditions: Abstract-only primary research on another formulation with a novel resin.

Case applicability: Motivates endpoints and controls, with no direct formulation recommendation. Limits: No current-product composition, concentration, process or human performance inferred; published effects remain specific to that study.

[film-tradeoff](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/sccj/56/3/56_271/_article/-char/en)

### existing-formulation-family (agent_inference)

Commercial silicone film-former families exist; preserve or assess an established suitable base formula before introducing a new material.

Material/component: Existing silicone-resin film-former family and carrier; no chosen concentration. Conditions: Supplier role statement and abstract-only mechanism/trade-off evidence on a different formulation.

Case applicability: Provides a concrete existing-ingredient direction for the conditional brief while package loading remains the primary lever. Limits: No finished-product performance or safe/compatible concentration inferred. The study-specific novel resin is excluded; the cited commercial listing is not a purchasing recommendation or adopted formula.

[existing-filmformer](https://www.dow.com/en-us/pdp.dowsil-593-fluid.01225707z.html), [film-tradeoff](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/sccj/56/3/56_271/_article/-char/en)

## Proposed measurements and controls

All tests are proposed_not_run. Equipment, numerical acceptance targets and an available laboratory/partner are not assumed.

### loading-and-effort (proposed_not_run)

Reduce repeated manual excess removal without replacing it with extra dipping or poor coverage.

Control: Same existing formula and defined fill/handling conditions in the baseline and candidate package; compare an acceptable existing alternative separately.

Measure: Record load per withdrawal, mass manually removed, wipe/dip counts, end droplets and standardized coating uniformity. Use exploratory repeated loading before choosing a powered design.

No test performed or equipment assumed. Resolution/evaporation correction and acceptance targets must be set before mass claims; bench coating does not prove user satisfaction.

### finish-and-wear (proposed_not_run)

Check that easier loading preserves the intended thin-layer result.

Control: Baseline formula/package and candidate package at matched applied amount; include the ordinary instructed routine for the existing alternative.

Measure: Record coating appearance, drying, transfer/rub behavior and gloss-overcoat interaction with stated substrate, load and time. Human wear/comfort would require a separately scoped later assessment.

No numerical performance claim or safety conclusion. Abstract-only research provides endpoints, not a reproduced protocol or validated threshold.

### package-compatibility (proposed_not_run)

Identify material, seal, flock and handling defects before selecting a package.

Control: Same formula, storage conditions and fill state, with baseline closure and existing material options.

Measure: Observe leaks, closure/withdrawal force, material/adhesive changes, fiber loss, product loss and loading drift over repeat use under a later qualified protocol.

No stability, preservation, safety or regulatory acceptance established. Actual formula/solvent data and package specification are required; no purchasing or partner is assumed.

## Unknowns and stopping conditions

- Actual current formula rheology, current package geometry and material compatibility.
- Acceptance targets, meaningful convenience gain and willingness to switch shade/formula/price.
- Manufacturing fit, supplier qualification, minimum order and economics.
- Matched alternative suitability, finished-product wear, safety and stability.
- Retire the new-product premise if an acceptable available alternative achieves the desired result with an ordinary routine the target user accepts.
- Reject a package revision if it reduces removed mass but fails to reduce total effort, adds dips, or worsens the chosen coverage/wear result.
- Reframe or stop if shade, finish, retouching or price dominates the amount-control benefit, or no practical compatible stock combination exists.
- This is a conditional development concept, not demonstrated market absence or a validated formula.
- No concentrations, dose targets, proprietary recipe, novel resin, patent clearance, MOQ, manufacturing cost or regulatory qualification are specified.
- No prototype, purchase, outreach, human trial or laboratory measurement has occurred.
